**Syntax:** `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>` (omitting the operator is equivalent to `equal`).

| Operator | Meaning |
|---|---|
| equal | Equals (`=`) — the default when no operator is given |
| not_equal | Not equal (`!=`) |
| gt | Greater than (`>`) |
| lt | Less than (`<`) |
| gte / from | Greater than or equal (`>=`) |
| lte / to | Less than or equal (`<=`) |
| like | Contains (`LIKE %value%`) |
| in | In a list of values |
| not_in | Not in a list of values |
| is_null | Field is null |
| is_not_null | Field is not null |
